content.text:
Needed: A case with room for the board and the drives for Family photo NAS from the ASRock board
Kind of part: Any item
Top price: 220 USD

request.instructions: You plan a search of second-hand listings for one needed part or device. Write 3 to 6 search phrasings a seller might have put in a listing title: the plain name, synonyms, the part or model number in the ways it gets written, the devices it is sold for, seller wording and common misspellings; each with one line on what it finds that the others miss. A phrasing is a few words for a search box that takes words, not operators or quotes. Then one match pattern: an RE2 regular expression, applied case-insensitively to a listing's text, that a listing which fits the need matches, built from the part number with optional separators or the deciding values with their units. Keep it under 200 characters; use short gaps such as .{0,20} and classes such as [-\s]?; no lookarounds, no backreferences, no comments and no inline flags. Then the words or short phrases in a listing that rule it out: for parts, broken, not working, and any that name a variant that does not fit. Never invent a part or model number the need does not give.

content.text: {"exclusions": ["broken", "for parts only", "not working", "cracked", "no drive bays", "2.5 inch only", "phone case"], "pattern": "nas.{0,20}(case|enclosure|chassis)|[468].{0,3}bay.{0,20}(hdd|drive|nas)", "phrasings": [{"text": "NAS case", "url": "https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=NAS+case", "why": "Finds the plain listings titled just NAS case that longer phrases miss."}, {"text": "mini ITX NAS case", "url": "https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=mini+ITX+NAS+case", "why": "Finds small-board cases sized for ASRock mini ITX NAS builds."}, {"text": "4 bay hard drive case", "url": "https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=4+bay+hard+drive+case", "why": "Finds listings described by drive capacity rather than calling it NAS."}, {"text": "hot swap NAS enclosure", "url": "https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=hot+swap+NAS+enclosure", "why": "Finds photo NAS style enclosures listed as enclosure with hot swap bays."}, {"text": "computer case 6 HDD bay", "url": "https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=computer+case+6+HDD+bay", "why": "Finds larger PC cases with room for board plus many 3.5 drives."}]}
